title: some days ago I posted about BMO and got good feedback
author: GreatAdvantage57
selftext:
Hi there, hope you remember me

The character spritesheet and animation became very good. Now, I can already generate a character, the walking animation, and directly export it to Unity (second example with witch)

I changed the approach and found that the way with video generation is much safer and better. Still, there were problems with frames, but as you can see, they are solved. 

  
I truly believe in power of AI in asset generation. ask any questions, I will still continue with showing my progress over time

comments.author: GreatAdvantage57
comments.body: is it possible to share video in reddit? its fine if not, but it would show how the character is walking

comments.author: BoltVnderhuge
comments.body: Can it handle walking animations for non bipedal creatures? Like dogs, cats, spiders, etc

replies.author: GreatAdvantage57
replies.body: of course, By the way, I also tried on a human character too.

replies.author: BoltVnderhuge
replies.body:
Cool! Excited to try it out later today. 

Is it specific to unity or does it also make generic sprite sheets that work for other programs?

replies.author: GreatAdvantage57
replies.body: As of now, you can export to unity with all files + spritesheet. But you can generate and get only spritesheet and use as you want. btw, you can join waitlist if you want: assetforge \[dot\] com

comments.author: Spare-Statistician30
comments.body: How are you generating the characters?

comments.author: _BashouT
comments.body: Are you going to share actual pipeline or product?

replies.author: GreatAdvantage57
replies.body: the product, you can join waitlist if you want: assetforge \[dot\] art

comments.author: win-win-win-win_win
comments.body: The strongest proof now would be a repeatability demo, not another best-case sprite: run the same character through idle → walk → attack, then show the raw frames, the rejected or cleaned frames, and the final Unity import. If you report how many frames needed manual repair and whether pivots and bounds stay stable, people can judge the pipeline rather than a curated output. I’d also include one non-biped and one long-garment or long-hair case; those expose temporal drift much faster than a simple walk cycle.

replies.author: GreatAdvantage57
replies.body:
100%  
I will definetely show the full workflow. As time passes I am planning to show step by step. First, show a demo of one animation creation. Then, when the product's V1 finishes I will share a youtube video where I will create a whole asset pack for a random game

replies.author: ffxivthrowaway03
replies.body: Also the hardest test of all - consistency of the same character facing different directions. This is where every single one of these tools fails, because it's cherry picking the best from a batch of each in the background, and none of it lines up.
